phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F5 Phase C — Bilateral Equity Subcomponent Bridge
purpose: Test whether bilateral F51 equity can be reconstructed exactly from listed shares, unlisted shares and other equity, then combine any resolved F51 with the already established F52 issuer-applicability rule to form total-F5 candidates.
promotion_rule: This phase may classify bilateral F51/F5 candidates only. F51 requires all three F511/F512/F519 subcomponents to be separately resolved without orientation conflict. Total F5 additionally requires F52 to be resolved or structurally not applicable under the already established Phase B rule. Materialization is prohibited until a later exact-rank and immutable-source gate.
negative_result_rule: If one or more F51 subcomponents are unavailable, F51 and total F5 remain unresolved for that bilateral cell. Aggregate residuals are never allocated.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery; behavioural closure remains inactive.
